argument_summary: The admissible record supports certification only on a narrow, disclosure-based theory: current aggregate readiness passed by 2.2 percentage points with no severity-one rehearsal incidents, while the grant compliance slice is a current material weakness that must be explicitly carried in current release documentation. The prior approval and informal monitoring note are contextual only. The overbroad claim to reject is present clean compliance without the disclosure cure; the narrower supportable claim is caveated certification conditioned on the packet/model-card reflecting the current evaluation results and the current subgroup limitation.
claims_about_business_cost: No business-cost exception is needed to support that narrower path. A bounded documentation cure is more proportionate than escalation because the admissible evidence already supports aggregate launch readiness and identifies the exact limitation that must be disclosed.
claims_about_policy: Policy does not require blocking certification whenever a subgroup weakness exists; it requires that current release documentation reflect current evaluation results and that material segment weaknesses for named launch use cases be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved mitigation. On the present admissible record, there is no basis to treat the stale prior approval or the informal monitoring comment as substitutes for current-release documentation or reviewed risk acceptance. The compliant path is therefore certification with explicit current-release disclosure of the grant compliance regression, not certification on stale approval theory.
concessions: The current record does not support an unqualified claim that certification is already compliant before the current release documentation is updated.
The grant compliance regression is material to a named launch use case and cannot be dismissed by aggregate readiness alone.
The prior approval predates the retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot carry the present certification decision by itself.
The informal monitoring comment is not reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or approved risk acceptance.
